room_status.description: Where the room stands: version, files, open proposals. Params: {}

running_work.description: Work the agents are doing in this room now: who asked, what, since when. Params: {}

room_history.description: What the team has asked for and decided in this room, newest last: requests, proposals, who accepted or rejected what and why. Params: {"limit": 30}

read_file.description: A file as it is in the room now. Params: {"path": "plan.md"}

show_change.description: What a proposal changes, as a diff. Params: {"proposal": "p-1a2b3c4d"} (default: the thread's proposal)

ask_agents.description: Ask the team's agents to do work, on the room's files or in the systems they work in; changes to files come back as a proposal in this thread. Params: {"goal": "<the request, complete enough to act on alone>", "title": "<a short name for the work, up to 8 words>"}

update_work.description: Add the person's message to work still running: when that work finishes, the agents take it up from its result, with every addition made meanwhile. Params: {"work": "<workflow id from work_running_now; default: the only running work>", "change": "<what to add or change, as you understand it>"}

request_changes.description: Have the agents redo a proposal with the person's feedback (their message is passed on as they wrote it); the redone version replaces it. Params: {"feedback": "<what to change, as you understand it>", "proposal": "p-..." (default: the thread's)}

propose_version.description: File a ``` block the person pasted in their message, exactly as pasted, as their version of a file. Params: {"path": "plan.md", "pasted_block": 1}

prepare_decision.description: Prepare a decision for the person to confirm with one tap; nothing happens until they do. Params: {"action": "accept|reject|release|discard|stop|approve|decline", "target": "<proposal id, workflow id for stop, or question id for approve/decline>", "reason": "<for reject, stop, decline>"}. release/discard: work held for the person. approve/decline: a question the agents asked for approval.

answer_question.description: Pass the person's message on, as they wrote it, as the answer to a question the agents asked the people here. Params: {"question": "<its id>"}

stay_quiet.description: The message is not for you (people talking to each other): nothing is posted. Params: {}

read_turn_result.description: Read the whole output of an earlier tool call (params: turn, optional offset/length).

recall.description: Ask what earlier sessions recorded about something (params: query, optional limit).

remember.description: Keep something worth knowing in a later session (params: fact, optional kind).

run_tool_program.description: Run a Python program that calls your tools as functions.

read_mailbox.description: Read durable unread peer notifications for this agent. Params: {"limit": 10}

inspect_workflow.description: Inspect this workflow's source goal, obligations, steps, dependencies, owners, and live statuses. Params: {}

read_workflow_step.description: Read one step definition and its durable output from this workflow. Params: {"step_id": "<step id>"}
